classification.difficultyReason: The first two parts scaffold algebraic distance expressions; equate those distances, square and solve the resulting linear equation.

content.prompt: A motorist departs from town $B$, which is $8\text{ km}$ due south from another town, $A$, and drives due east towards town $C$, which is $20\text{ km}$ from $B$. After driving a distance of $x\text{ km}$, he notices that he is the same distance away from both towns $A$ and $C$.

spec.description: Right triangle ABD with B, D and C in order on a horizontal line. The whole BC dimension sits below the line. Source blue outlines and the isolated red point use ordinary black.
spec.mathematics: AB=8 km, BD=x km, BC=20 km, AB perpendicular to BC; AD=DC is given in the stem.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens appear; no solved distance.

sizing.exceptionReason: The whole-distance arrow and four town/position labels require a wide, shallow figure.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Express the motorist’s distance from $A$ in terms of $x$ (that is, $AD$).

children.label: b
children.prompt: Express the motorist’s distance from $C$ in terms of $x$.

children.label: c
children.prompt: Find the distance he has driven from $B$.

answer.worked:
The distances $AD$ and $DC$ are equal.
$$\begin{align*}\sqrt{64+x^2}&=20-x\\64+x^2&=(20-x)^2\\64+x^2&=400-40x+x^2\\64&=400-40x\\40x&=336\\x&=8.4\end{align*}$$
The motorist has driven $8.4\text{ km}$.
